articles.title: Kani slams Vijay over murders
articles.summary: DMK MP Kanimozhi slams CM C Joseph Vijay over violent crimes in Thoothukudi, cites multiple murders, calls it a “reels govt” and urges better policing.
articles.body: Madurai: DMK MP Kanimozhi on Friday accused chief minister C Joseph Vijay of failing to ensure public safety amid a series of violent crimes, dubbing his administration a “reels govt”.In an X post, she cited the stoning of a youth at Kulasekarapattinam Dasara festival, a fisherman’s murder in Threspuram and a sickle attack on a watchman in Srivaikuntam. Calling Tuticorin a “killing field,” she urged Vijay to entrust policing to someone competent.Speaking to reporters following a woman’s murder near Sathankulam, Kanimozhi said people faced an ‘atmosphere of insecurity’ despite Vijay’s assurances.
